case_name: Dependency Cap Triggering — Cascade from Governance Weakness
case_description: Large regional bank assessed in HYBRID mode with governance weakness (P1C2 < 2.5) triggering cross-pillar dependency caps on P3 subcaps. Also tests cybersecurity breach cap cascade: P4C4 < 2.5 triggers cap on P4C1 (Data Governance), which may cascade to P2C4 (Personalization). Exercises the two-pass dependency cap algorithm fully.

expected_outcomes.rationale: Strong CX and some operational maturity constrained by governance weakness and breach history. Cross-pillar caps significantly depress P3 and parts of P4. Overall score pulled down by cascading dependency effects.

expected_pillar_scores.P1_rationale: Governance weakness (P1C2 < 2.5) drags pillar down despite reasonable P1C1 strategy scores
expected_pillar_scores.P2_rationale: Strong customer experience; may be partially capped by P2C4 cascade if P4C1 < 2.5
expected_pillar_scores.P3_rationale: All subcaps capped at 3.0 by P1C2 governance dependency; actual operational scores may be higher but are constrained
expected_pillar_scores.P4_rationale: Breach caps P4C4; cascade caps P4C1; technology portfolio otherwise mid-M3

cross_pillar_caps.rationale: Governance dependency is the primary constraint

severity_caps.rationale: Material breach 15 months ago triggers severity cap

test_tolerances.rationale: Cascade interactions create some variance; tolerance reflects compounding uncertainty

regression_test_gate.test_case_purpose: Verify two-pass dependency cap algorithm executes correctly: (1) First pass applies P1C2→P3 and breach→P4C4 caps, (2) Second pass detects P4C4<2.5→P4C1 cascade and optional P4C1<2.5→P2C4 cascade, (3) Aggregation recalculates correctly after all caps applied
pass_criteria: ALL P3 subcaps have Final_Score ≤ 3.0 with CROSS_PILLAR cap logged
P4C1 has CROSS_PILLAR cap from P4C4 dependency
Post-cap aggregation is mathematically correct (AG-01 through AG-12 pass)
If cascade to P2C4 fires: documented in log with correct cap value
